words.ex: He watches a sitcom every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看一部情景喜剧。
words.en: A sitcom is a genre of comedy centered on a fixed set of characters who carry over from episode to episode. Sitcoms usually take place in a common environment such as a home or workplace.

words.ex: He laughs at the situation comedy on TV every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都看情景喜剧并大笑。
words.en: A situation comedy, or sitcom, is a genre of comedy centered on a fixed set of characters who carry over from episode to episode. These characters are often involved in humorous situations and misunderstandings.

words.ex: I read the news every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上看新闻。
words.en: News is information about recent events or happenings, especially as reported by newspapers, radio, television, or online media.

words.ex: He washes his hands with soap.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥皂洗手。
words.en: A substance used with water for washing and cleaning, made of a compound of natural oils or fats with sodium hydroxide or another strong alkali, and typically also perfume and coloring.

words.tr: adj. 教育的；有教育意义的；
words.ex: This is an educational video for children.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个为儿童制作的教育视频。
words.en: Educational means relating to education or the process of education.

words.tr:
n. 计划；打算；
v. 计划；打算；
words.ex: He made a plan to visit his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个去看望祖父母的计划。
words.en: A plan is a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.

words.tr:
v. 希望；
n. 希望；
words.ex: I hope it rains tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我希望明天下雨。
words.en: If you hope that something is true, or if you hope for something, you want it to be true or to happen, and you usually believe that it is possible or likely.

words.ex: I want to find out why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想弄清楚他为什么迟到。
words.en: To discover a fact or piece of information, often by making an effort to do so.

words.ex: We had a discussion about homework.
words.ex_cn: 我们进行了一次关于作业的讨论。
words.en: A discussion is a conversation or debate about a specific topic.

words.tr:
v. 站立；忍受；
n. 立足点；
words.ex: The boy stands near the door.
words.ex_cn: 男孩站在门附近。
words.en: If you stand somewhere, you are in an upright position with your feet on the ground. If something stands somewhere, it is in an upright position in that place.

words.ex: The accident happened yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 事故昨天发生了。
words.en: If something happens, it occurs as a result of a situation or course of action.

words.ex: My birthday is in May.
words.ex_cn: 我的生日在五月。
words.en: May is the fifth month of the Gregorian calendar, following April and preceding June.

words.ex: I expect a gift on my birthday.
words.ex_cn: 我期待在生日时收到一份礼物。
words.en: If you expect something, you believe that it is likely to happen or that it will be the case.

words.tr:
n. 笑话；玩笑；
v. 开玩笑；
words.ex: He told a funny joke at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上讲了一个有趣的笑话。
words.en: A joke is something that is said or done to make people laugh, especially a funny story or a trick played on someone.

words.ex: He likes to watch comedy on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看喜剧。
words.en: A comedy is a type of drama or other art form the main object of which, according to modern notions, is to amuse.

words.ex: The talk was meaningless and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这场谈话毫无意义且无聊。
words.en: If something is meaningless, it has no meaning, or seems to have no meaning.

words.ex: The government took quick action to fix the problem.
words.ex_cn: 政府迅速采取行动解决问题。
words.en: The fact or process of doing something, typically to achieve an aim.

words.tr: phrase. 动作电影；以打斗、追逐、爆炸等激烈场面为主要特征的影片
words.ex: He likes to watch action movie on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看动作片。
words.en: A film genre that features exciting sequences such as fights, chases, and explosions, often with a fast-paced plot.

words.ex: My brother watches cartoon every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天晚上看卡通片。
words.en: A cartoon is a humorous drawing or series of drawings in a newspaper or magazine, or a film made using animation techniques.

words.ex: I love learning about different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢了解不同的文化。
words.en: The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular people or society.

words.ex: He is a famous singer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的歌手。
words.en: Known about by many people.

words.ex: The sun appears in the sky at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在黎明时出现。
words.en: If someone or something appears, they come into sight or become noticeable.

words.ex: The caterpillar becomes a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫变成蝴蝶。
words.en: To begin to be something or to develop into something.

words.tr: v. 变成；成为；变得；“become”的过去式；
words.ex: He became a teacher after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他毕业后成为一名老师。
words.en: the past tense of 'become', which means to begin to be something

words.tr: adj. 丰饶的；富有的；富裕的；
words.ex: The land is rich in minerals.
words.ex_cn: 这片土地矿物丰富。
words.en: Having a great deal of money or assets; wealthy.

words.ex: He is a successful businessman.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成功的商人。
words.en: Achieving the results wanted or hoped for.

words.tr: v. 可能；也许；“may”的过去式； n. 强大力量；
words.ex: He might come to the party tonight.
words.ex_cn: 他今晚可能会来参加派对。
words.en: Might is used to indicate that something is possible or might happen, or to ask for permission in a polite way.

words.ex: The main reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The most important part or aspect of something.

words.tr:
n. 原因；理由；理性；
v. 推理；推断；
words.ex: The reason for his absence is sickness.
words.ex_cn: 他缺席的原因是生病。
words.en: A reason is an explanation or justification for an action, belief, or occurrence.

words.tr: adj. 常见的；普通的；共有的；
words.ex: Colds are a common illness in winter.
words.ex_cn: 感冒在冬天是很常见的疾病。
words.en: Something that is common happens often or is found in many places.

words.tr:
n. 电影；底片；薄薄的一层；
v. 拍摄电影；
words.ex: I watched a funny film last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚看了一部有趣的电影。
words.en: A film is a series of moving pictures, usually shown in a cinema or on television and often telling a story.

words.ex: He watches a movie every Friday night.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五晚上都看电影。
words.en: A movie is a story or event recorded by a camera as a set of moving images and shown in a cinema or on television.

words.ex: He is unlucky because he lost his wallet.
words.ex_cn: 他很倒霉，因为他丢了钱包。
words.en: If someone is unlucky, they have bad luck.

words.ex: He lost his keys yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天丢了钥匙。
words.en: If you lose something, you no longer have it or you cannot find it.

words.tr: adj. 丢失的； v. 丢失；输；“lose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The lost keys were found under the table.
words.ex_cn: 丢失的钥匙在桌子下面找到了。
words.en: If you are lost, you do not know where you are or you are unable to find your way.

words.ex: He is talking to his girlfriend on the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他正在和女朋友打电话。
words.en: A girlfriend is a woman or girl with whom someone is having a romantic or sexual relationship.

words.ex: I am ready for the test.
words.ex_cn: 我准备好考试了。
words.en: If you are ready, you are prepared for something or are in a suitable state to do or deal with it.

words.tr: phrase. 准备好做某事；愿意做某事
words.ex_cn: 他准备帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To be prepared or willing to do something.

words.tr: n. 性格；人物角色；特点；
words.ex: His character is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的性格善良且有耐心。
words.en: The combination of qualities or features that distinguishes one person, group, or thing from another.

words.ex: This is a simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是一道简单的数学题。
words.en: If you describe something as simple, you mean that it is not complicated, and is therefore easy to understand.

words.tr: phrase. 装扮；穿上盛装；乔装打扮
words.ex: The children dress up as pirates for Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在万圣节打扮成海盗。
words.en: To wear formal or special clothes for a particular occasion or to make something or someone look more attractive by adding decorations or details.

words.tr: phrase. 代替某人；取代某人的位置
words.ex: He will take his brother's place in the game.
words.ex_cn: 他将代替他哥哥参加比赛。
words.en: To take someone's place means to do something that another person was going to do, because they are unable to do it.

words.ex: The army trains new soldiers every month.
words.ex_cn: 军队每个月训练新兵。
words.en: An army is a large organized group of people who are armed and trained to fight on land in a war.

words.tr: 短语动词. 做得好；把某事完成得很出色
words.ex: You did a good job on the cleaning.
words.ex_cn: 你把清洁工作做得很好。
words.en: To perform a task or duty well.

words.ex: Sarah goes to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 莎拉每天去上学。
words.en: A female given name, of Hebrew origin, meaning 'princess'.

words.tr: 专有名词。沃尔特·迪士尼，美国著名动画师、电影制片人、企业家，迪士尼公司创始人
words.ex: Walt Disney created Mickey Mouse.
words.ex_cn: 沃尔特·迪士尼创造了米老鼠。
words.en: Walt Disney was an American animator, film producer, and entrepreneur, renowned for his influence in the field of entertainment during the 20th century.

words.tr: n. 迫击炮; vt. 用迫击炮轰击
words.ex: The soldiers fired a minnie at the enemy bunker.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们向敌人的掩体发射了一门迫击炮。
words.en: Minnie is a fictional character created by The Walt Disney Company. As the longtime sweetheart of Mickey Mouse, she is an anthropomorphic mouse with a sweet voice and cheerful personality.

words.tr: phrase. 米老鼠（迪士尼经典卡通形象）；[贬] 小儿科的；微不足道的；幼稚的
words.ex: He loves watching Mickey Mouse on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看米老鼠。
words.en: Mickey Mouse is a cartoon character created by Walt Disney and Ub Iwerks in 1928. He is an anthropomorphic mouse who typically wears red shorts, large yellow shoes, and white gloves. Mickey Mouse is one of the most recognizable and enduring symbols of The Walt Disney Company.

words.tr: phrase. 《汽船威利号》，迪士尼1928年推出的经典动画短片，是米老鼠首次公开亮相的作品
words.ex: Steamboat Willie is an old cartoon with Mickey Mouse.
words.ex_cn: 《汽船威利》是一部有米老鼠的旧卡通。
words.en: Steamboat Willie is a 1928 American animated short film directed by Walt Disney and Ub Iwerks. It is notable for being the first Disney cartoon with synchronized sound and for introducing the character Mickey Mouse.

words.tr: n. 好莱坞（美国电影业中心）
words.ex: He wants to work in Hollywood.
words.ex_cn: 他想在好莱坞工作。
words.en: Hollywood is an area in Los Angeles, California, known for its influence in the film industry, serving as the historical center of movie studios and stars.

words.tr: phrase. 好莱坞星光大道（位于美国加州洛杉矶，表彰娱乐产业杰出人物的著名人行道）
words.ex: She walked on the Hollywood Walk of Fame with her fans.
words.ex_cn: 她和粉丝们一起走在好莱坞星光大道上。
words.en: The Hollywood Walk of Fame is a historic landmark which consists of more than 2,700 five-pointed terrazzo and brass stars embedded in the sidewalks along 15 blocks of Hollywood Boulevard and three blocks of Vine Street in Hollywood, California.

words.ex: He wants to grow up and be a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他想长大后当一名医生。
words.en: To grow up means to gradually change from being a child to being an adult. This process involves physical, emotional, and intellectual development.

words.ex: He is a computer programmer who writes code every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名计算机程序员，每天写代码。
words.en: A computer programmer is a person who writes computer programs.

words.ex: The cooks prepare dinner every evening.
words.ex_cn: 厨师们每天晚上准备晚餐。
words.en: To prepare food by heating it, often by boiling, baking, or frying. Also refers to a person who prepares and cooks food, especially as a job.

words.ex: The doctor helped the sick child.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助了生病的孩子。
words.en: A doctor is someone who is qualified in medicine and treats people who are ill.

words.ex: He is an engineer who builds bridges.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名建造桥梁的工程师。
words.en: An engineer is a person who designs, builds, or maintains engines, machines, or public works.

words.tr: n. 小提琴手；小提琴演奏者；
words.ex: The violinist played a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 小提琴手在音乐会上演奏了一首优美的曲子。
words.en: A violinist is a person who plays the violin.

words.ex: The driver stopped the car at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 司机在红灯处停了车。
words.en: A driver is a person who drives a vehicle.

words.ex: The pilot landed the plane safely.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员安全地降落了飞机。
words.en: A pilot is a person who operates the flying controls of an aircraft. Also, to pilot something means to test or introduce a new idea, product, etc., to see if it will be successful.

words.tr: n. 钢琴家；钢琴弹奏者；
words.ex: The pianist played a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位钢琴家在音乐会上演奏了一首美妙的曲子。
words.en: A pianist is a person who plays the piano, especially professionally.

words.ex: The scientist studies stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家研究夜空中的恒星。
words.en: A scientist is someone who has studied science and whose job is to teach or do research in science.

words.tr: phrase. v. 对……有把握；确信……
words.ex: I am not sure about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我不确定这个答案。
words.en: To be certain or confident about something.

words.tr: phrase. 确保；确定；核实；查明
words.ex: Make sure you lock the door before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前确保锁好门。
words.en: To make certain that something is done or happens.

words.ex: He works at a small college.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所小型学院工作。
words.en: A college is an institution where students study after they have left school, in order to get a degree or qualification.

words.ex: He values education very much.
words.ex_cn: 他非常重视教育。
words.en: Education is the process of teaching and learning, especially in a school or college, or the knowledge that you get from this.

words.ex: He wants to study medicine at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习医学。
words.en: Medicine is the science or practice of the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease.

words.ex: He goes to university to study engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他上大学学习工程。
words.en: A university is an institution where students study for degrees and where academic research is done.

words.ex: He lives in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦。
words.en: London is the capital city of England and the United Kingdom, known for its history, culture, and financial services.

words.ex: He wrote an article about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的文章。
words.en: An article is a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or online. It can also refer to a particular item or object, or a clause in a legal document.

words.ex: I send a message to my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我给朋友发送一条消息。
words.en: To cause to go or be taken to a particular destination; dispatch.

words.ex: The resolution of the conflict took many meetings.
words.ex_cn: 这个冲突的解决花了多次会议。
words.en: A resolution is a formal decision made at a meeting by the vote of the people who are there. It can also refer to a firm decision to do or not to do something.

words.ex: Our team won the soccer match.
words.ex_cn: 我们的团队赢得了足球比赛。
words.en: A team is a group of people who play a particular sport or game together against other similar groups of people.

words.ex: He loves eating foreign food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吃什么外国食物。
words.en: belonging to or connected with a country that is not your own

words.tr: adj. 能够；能…的；有能力的；
words.ex: He is able to swim across the river.
words.ex_cn: 他能够游过这条河。
words.en: If you are able to do something, you have the skills, strength, knowledge, or other qualities needed to do it.

words.ex: He is able to swim very well.
words.ex_cn: 他能游得很好。
words.en: To have the power, skill, means, or opportunity to do something.

words.ex: He answered all the questions correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他全部答对了这些问题。
words.en: Questions are sentences or phrases that ask for information, opinions, or instructions.

words.tr: n. 意思；意义； v. 表示…的意思；意思；“mean”的现在分词；
words.ex: What is the meaning of this word?
words.ex_cn: 这个词的意思是什么？
words.en: The meaning of something is what it expresses or represents.

words.ex: We will discuss the homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天讨论作业。
words.en: To discuss something means to talk about it with someone and tell each other your ideas or opinions.

words.tr:
v. 承诺；答应；
n. 许诺；希望；成功的征兆（或理由）；
words.ex: He promised to help me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮我做作业。
words.en: A promise is a statement that you will definitely do something or that something will definitely happen.

words.tr: n. 开头；开端； v. 开始；着手；“begin”的现在分词；
words.ex: The beginning of the story is very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的开头非常精彩。
words.en: The point in time or space at which something starts.

words.ex: At the beginning of the class, the teacher gave us homework.
words.ex_cn: 在课程开始时，老师给我们布置了作业。
words.en: At the start of something; at the point when something starts.

words.ex: He works hard to improve his English.
words.ex_cn: 他努力改善自己的英语。
words.en: To make something better, or to become better.

words.ex: Please write down your name.
words.ex_cn: 请写下你的名字。
words.en: To record something in writing.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.tr: pron. 他们自己；她们自己；它们自己；
words.ex: The children cleaned the room themselves.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们自己打扫了房间。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to a group of people or things previously mentioned as the subject of the clause.

words.ex: This problem has to do with counting money.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题与数钱有关。
words.en: to be connected or associated with something

words.ex: He practices self-improvement every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在进行自我提升。
words.en: Self-improvement refers to the process by which a person improves their knowledge, status, or character by their own efforts.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.ex: He reads books as a hobby.
words.ex_cn: 他读书作为一种爱好。
words.en: A hobby is an activity that you enjoy doing in your spare time.

words.tr:
adj. 每周的；
adv. 每周；
words.ex: He gets paid weekly.
words.ex_cn: 他每周领工资。
words.en: Happening or done once a week or every week; a newspaper or magazine that is published once a week.

words.tr: n. 学校作业；课堂作业；
words.ex: He finished his schoolwork before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚饭前完成了学校作业。
words.en: Schoolwork refers to the work that students are required to do as part of their studies at school.

words.ex: I have one apple.
words.ex_cn: 我有一个苹果。
words.en: One is used to refer to the first and lowest whole number, often used to indicate a single person or thing.

words.ex: This is my personal notebook.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的个人笔记本。
words.en: Relating to or belonging to a particular person rather than to a group or an organization.

words.ex: They have a good relationship with their neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他们和邻居关系很好。
words.en: A relationship is the way in which two or more people or things are connected, or the state of being connected.

words.ex: Andy is my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 安迪是我最好的朋友。
words.en: A male given name, of Greek origin, meaning 'manly' or 'brave'.

words.ex: His ken does not include quantum physics.
words.ex_cn: 他的知识范围不包括量子物理。
words.en: Ken is the range of one's knowledge or understanding.

words.tr: n. 海明威（美国著名作家，代表作有《老人与海》等）；
words.ex: Hemingway wrote The Old Man and the Sea.
words.ex_cn: 海明威写了《老人与海》。
words.en: Hemingway refers to Ernest Hemingway, an American novelist, short-story writer, and journalist, known for his economical and understated style, which had a strong influence on 20th-century fiction.

words.ex: The leaves turned a bright kelly in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，树叶变成了鲜亮的黄绿色。
words.en: A female given name, of Irish origin, meaning 'bright-headed'.

words.w: The Old Man and the Sea
words.tr: phrase. 《老人与海》——美国作家海明威所著中篇小说，讲述一位老渔夫与一条大鱼搏斗的故事
words.uk: ði əʊld mæn ænd ði siː
words.us: ðə oʊld mæn ænd ði si
words.ex: He read The Old Man and the Sea for his English class.
words.ex_cn: 他为英语课读了《老人与海》。
words.en: The Old Man and the Sea is a novel by Ernest Hemingway, published in 1952. It tells the story of Santiago, an aging fisherman, and his struggle with a giant marlin far out in the Gulf Stream.

words.ex: He wrote his name on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上写了名字。
words.en: A material made from cellulose pulp, derived mainly from wood, rags, and certain grasses, processed into flexible sheets or rolls by deposit from an aqueous suspension, and used chiefly for writing, printing, drawing, wrapping, and covering walls.

words.ex: The river is dirty because of pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这条河因为污染而变得肮脏。
words.en: Pollution is the process of making air, water, soil, etc. dirty and not safe or suitable to use.

words.ex: The weather prediction says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: A prediction is a statement about what you think will happen in the future.

words.tr:
n. 未来；将来；前途；
adj. 将来的；未来的；
words.ex: We cannot predict the future.
words.ex_cn: 我们无法预测未来。
words.en: The future is the time after the present, or the events that will happen then.

words.ex: The factory pollutes the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂污染了这条河。
words.en: To pollute water, air, or land means to make it dirty and dangerous to live in or to use, especially with poisonous chemicals or waste.

words.ex: He protects the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
words.en: The environment is the natural world in which people, animals, and plants live.

words.ex: The planet Mars is red.
words.ex_cn: 火星是红色的。
words.en: A planet is a large object in space that moves around a star, such as the sun, and does not produce its own light.

words.ex: The earth goes around the sun.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕太阳运转。
words.en: The planet on which we live; the land surface of the world as distinct from the sea or the air.

words.tr:
n. 植物；工厂；发电厂；装置；
v. 种植；栽培；
words.ex: The plant grows near the window.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物长在窗边。
words.en: A plant is a living thing that grows in the earth and has a stem, leaves, and roots. As a verb, to plant means to put a seed or plant into the ground so that it will grow.

words.tr:
n. 部分；局部；角色；零件；
v. 分离；分开；
words.ex: This part of the book is very easy.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的这一部分非常简单。
words.en: A part is one of the pieces, sections, or elements that together with others constitute a whole.

words.tr: phrase. 起作用；参与；扮演角色
words.ex: Every student can play a part in making the school better.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都能在改善学校方面起作用。
words.en: If you play a part in a situation or event, you are involved in it and have an effect on it.

words.ex: The two countries signed a treaty for peace.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了和平条约。
words.en: Peace is a situation or a period of time in which there is no war or violence in a country or an area.

words.ex: The fish swim in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海里游泳。
words.en: The sea is the salty water that covers about three-quarters of the Earth's surface.

words.ex: The sky is blue today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是蓝色的。
words.en: The sky is the space around the Earth which you can see when you stand outside and look upwards.

words.ex: The astronaut walked on the moon.
words.ex_cn: 这名宇航员在月球上行走。
words.en: An astronaut is a person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft.

words.tr: n. 单元住宅；公寓住宅；
words.ex: He lives in a small apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一间小公寓里。
words.en: An apartment is a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a large building.

words.ex: The rocket flew into space.
words.ex_cn: 火箭飞入了太空。
words.en: A rocket is a spacecraft, aircraft, or other vehicle that obtains thrust from a rocket engine.

words.tr:
n. 空间；太空；空格；
v. 以一定间隔排列；
words.ex: The room has enough space for a bed and a desk.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有足够的空间放一张床和一张书桌。
words.en: Space refers to the physical dimensions in which objects exist and move, including the vast expanse beyond the Earth's atmosphere, known as outer space. It can also denote the interval or distance between two or more objects, or a period of time. As a verb, it means to arrange with spaces in between.

words.ex: Astronauts live on a space station.
words.ex_cn: 宇航员住在空间站里。
words.en: A space station is a large artificial satellite used as a long-term base for manned operations in space.

words.tr:
adj. 人的；人类的；
n. 人；人类；
words.ex: Human emotions are complex and powerful.
words.ex_cn: 人的情感复杂而强大。
words.en: A human is a member of the species Homo sapiens, distinguished from other animals by superior mental development, power of articulate speech, and upright stance.

words.ex: The servant cleaned the house every morning.
words.ex_cn: 仆人每天早上打扫房子。
words.en: A servant is someone who is employed to work in another person's house, doing jobs such as cooking and cleaning.

words.ex: The river is dangerous for children.
words.ex_cn: 这条河对孩子来说很危险。
words.en: If something is dangerous, it is able or likely to hurt or harm you.

words.ex: He has already finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他已经完成了他的作业。
words.en: You use already to say that something has happened, or that something had happened before the moment you are referring to.

words.ex: The factory makes cars.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂生产汽车。
words.en: A factory is a large building where machines are used to make goods in large quantities.

words.tr: phrase. 一次又一次地；反复地；不断地
words.ex: He practiced the song over and over again.
words.ex_cn: 他一遍又一遍地练习这首歌。
words.en: Repeatedly; many times.

words.ex: I believe you are telling the truth.
words.ex_cn: 我相信你在说真话。
words.en: If you believe in something, you think that it is true, or that it exists.

words.ex: I disagree with your opinion.
words.ex_cn: 我不同意你的观点。
words.en: If you disagree with someone or disagree with what they say, you do not accept that what they say is true or you do not accept that it is the correct thing to do.

words.tr:
adv. 甚至；甚至于；
adj. 平坦的；
words.ex: He didn't even say goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他甚至连再见都没说。
words.en: Even is used to emphasize something that is surprising or unlikely. It can also describe something that is flat, smooth, or level, or something that is equal in amount, degree, or value.

words.ex: Hundreds of students came to the event.
words.ex_cn: 有数百名学生参加了这个活动。
words.en: Used to emphasize a large but indefinite number of things or people.

words.tr:
n. 形状；身材；定形；
v. 塑造；
words.ex: The shape of the table is round.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子的形状是圆形的。
words.en: The shape of an object is its external form or outline, which can be seen and felt.

words.tr:
v. 下降；跌倒；
n. 落下；跌落；秋天；
words.ex: The temperature falls quickly at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚温度迅速下降。
words.en: To move downward, typically rapidly and freely without control, from a higher to a lower level.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 跌倒；倒塌；失败
words.ex: The boy fell down from the chair.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从椅子上摔了下来。
words.en: To fall down means to move from a higher to a lower position, typically rapidly and without control, often resulting in landing on the ground.

words.tr:
prep. 在（或向）…内；
n. 内部；里面；
adv. 在（或向）里面；
adj. 内部的；里面的；
words.ex: The keys are inside the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙在抽屉里。
words.en: The inside of something is the part that is normally enclosed or hidden by its outer surface.

words.ex: He looks for his keys every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都找他的钥匙。
words.en: To search for something or someone.

words.ex: It is possible to learn English quickly.
words.ex_cn: 快速学会英语是可能的。
words.en: If something is possible, it can be done or achieved.

words.ex: It is impossible to finish the race in five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 五分钟内完成比赛是不可能的。
words.en: If something is impossible, it cannot be done or cannot happen.

words.ex: The cat sat on the side of the bed.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在床的旁边。
words.en: One of the two or more parts or areas into which something is divided, or one of the two surfaces of something flat and thin, such as paper.

words.ex: He will probably come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能来参加派对。
words.en: Used to say that something is likely to be true or likely to happen.

words.ex: He slept during the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在看电影时睡着了。
words.en: Throughout the course or duration of (a period of time).

words.ex: We went to the beach during the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假日去了海滩。
words.en: A holiday is a day of festivity or recreation when no work is done.

words.tr:
n. 词；单词；话语；
v. 用词语表达；
words.ex: This word means 'happy' in English.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在英语中意思是‘高兴’。
words.en: A single unit of language that has meaning and can be spoken or written.

words.ex: The knife left a nick on the wooden table.
words.ex_cn: 刀在木桌上留下了一道刻痕。
words.en: A nick is a small cut or notch in a surface or edge. As a verb, to nick means to make a small cut or notch in something, or to steal something.

words.ex: James is my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 詹姆士是我最好的朋友。
words.en: A male given name, of Hebrew origin, meaning 'supplanter'.

words.tr:
adj. 白色的；
n. 白色；
words.ex: The white cat sat on the windowsill.
words.ex_cn: 白色的猫坐在窗台上。
words.en: White is the lightest color and is achromatic (having no hue), because it fully reflects and scatters all the visible wavelengths of light.

words.tr:
n. 摇动；颤动；
v. 摇动；颤动；
words.ex: The shake of the car made me feel sick.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的摇动让我感到恶心。
words.en: To move or cause to move with quick, short movements from side to side or up and down.

words.tr: phrase. 奶昔（即泡沫牛奶，将牛奶和冰激凌等混合后搅打至起泡的饮料）
words.ex: He drinks a milk shake after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后喝一杯奶昔。
words.en: A milk shake is a cold drink made of milk, ice cream, and often flavoring or sweetener, shaken or blended until frothy.

words.ex: He uses a blender to make smoothies.
words.ex_cn: 他用搅拌机做奶昔。
words.en: A blender is a kitchen appliance used to mix, purée, or emulsify food and other substances.

words.tr: phrase. 开启；接通；发动；突击
words.ex: He turns on the light in the room.
words.ex_cn: 他打开了房间的灯。
words.en: To cause something to start operating, especially by pressing a switch or button.

words.tr:
n. 果皮；
v. 去皮；剥落；
words.ex: The apple peel is rich in fiber.
words.ex_cn: 苹果皮富含纤维。
words.en: To remove the outer covering from something, especially a fruit or vegetable.

words.ex: He poured water into the glass.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进杯子里。
words.en: If you pour a liquid or other substance, you make it flow steadily out of a container by holding the container at an angle.

words.ex: I eat yogurt for breakfast every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早餐吃酸奶。
words.en: Yogurt is a slightly sour thick liquid made from milk with bacteria added to it, often eaten with fruit or used in cooking.

words.ex: She put honey on her toast.
words.ex_cn: 她在吐司上涂了蜂蜜。
words.en: Honey is a sweet, sticky, yellowish-brown fluid made by bees and other insects from nectar collected from flowers.

words.ex: He eats a watermelon every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都吃西瓜。
words.en: A watermelon is a large, round fruit with green skin, pink flesh, and black seeds.

words.ex: He picked up a spoon to eat the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起一把勺子喝汤。
words.en: A spoon is an object used for eating, stirring, and serving food. It has a small shallow bowl on a handle.

words.ex: She poured tea from the pot.
words.ex_cn: 她从壶里倒出了茶。
words.en: A pot is a deep round container used for cooking.

words.ex: He adds two and three to get five.
words.ex_cn: 他把二和三相加得到五。
words.en: To put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, or amount.

words.ex: He finally finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他终于完成了作业。
words.en: You use finally to suggest that something happens after a long period of time, usually later than you wanted or expected.

words.ex: She added a little salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她在汤里加了一点盐。
words.en: Salt is a white crystalline substance that is used for seasoning or preserving food. It is also used in various industrial processes.

words.ex: He put sugar in his tea.
words.ex_cn: 他把糖放进茶里。
words.en: A sweet substance that is used to make food and drinks sweet. It is usually in the form of white or brown crystals.

words.ex: He eats cheese every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃奶酪。
words.en: Cheese is a food made from the pressed curds of milk, often with added flavorings and sometimes with a hard or soft texture.

words.ex: He eats popcorn at the movie theater.
words.ex_cn: 他在电影院吃爆米花。
words.en: Popcorn is a variety of corn kernel which expands and puffs up when heated.

words.ex: He ate popcorn made from corn.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了用玉米做的爆米花。
words.en: Corn is a tall plant which produces long vegetables covered with yellow seeds. It is also a cereal crop.

words.ex: The factory uses a big machine to make cars.
words.ex_cn: 工厂用一台大机器制造汽车。
words.en: A machine is a piece of equipment which uses electricity or an engine in order to do a particular kind of work.

words.ex: He dig a hole in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里挖了一个洞。
words.en: To dig means to break up, turn over, or remove earth, sand, etc., using a tool, a machine, or your hands. It can also mean to search for something by moving or looking through something, or to like or enjoy something very much.

words.ex: There is a hole in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一个洞。
words.en: A hole is an opening or hollow space in something solid, or a place in the ground that is deeper than the surface around it.

words.ex: He eats a sandwich for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃三明治。
words.en: A sandwich consists of two slices of bread with a layer of food such as cheese or meat between them.

words.ex: She spread butter on her toast.
words.ex_cn: 她在吐司上抹了黄油。
words.en: Butter is a pale yellow edible fatty substance made by churning cream and used as a spread or in cooking.

words.ex: We ate turkey for Thanksgiving dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们在感恩节晚餐上吃了火鸡。
words.en: A turkey is a large bird that is often eaten at Christmas or Thanksgiving.

words.ex: She added lettuce to her sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 她在三明治里加了莴苣。
words.en: Lettuce is a plant with large green leaves that is eaten in salads.

words.tr:
n. 件；作品；片；块；
v. 拼凑；
words.ex: She bought a piece of cake.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一块蛋糕。
words.en: A piece of something is an amount of it that has been broken off, torn off, or cut off.

words.ex: We eat turkey on Thanksgiving.
words.ex_cn: 我们在感恩节吃火鸡。
words.en: Thanksgiving is a national holiday celebrated primarily in the United States and Canada as a day of giving thanks for the blessing of the harvest and of the preceding year.

words.ex: He wears traditional clothes on holidays.
words.ex_cn: 他在节日时穿传统服装。
words.en: Traditional refers to customs, beliefs, or methods that have existed for a long time without changing.

words.ex: Leaves fall in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 树叶在秋季落下。
words.en: Autumn is the season between summer and winter when leaves change color and the weather becomes cooler.

words.ex: The traveler walked through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅行者穿过森林。
words.en: A traveler is a person who is traveling or who often travels.

words.ex: The traveller visited five countries last summer.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅游者去年夏天访问了五个国家。
words.en: A traveller is a person who is travelling or who often travels.

words.ex: He was born in England.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在英格兰。
words.en: England is a country that is part of the United Kingdom. It shares land borders with Scotland to the north and Wales to the west; the Irish Sea is to the north west, the Celtic Sea to the south west, while the North Sea to the east and the English Channel to the south separate it from continental Europe.

words.ex: We celebrate my birthday with cake and friends.
words.ex_cn: 我们用蛋糕和朋友庆祝我的生日。
words.en: To celebrate means to mark a special day, event, or occasion with festivities or ceremonies. It can also mean to praise or honor someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 混合；结合；
v. 混合；掺入；合成；交往；
words.ex: The recipe calls for a mix of flour and sugar.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要一种面粉和糖的混合物。
words.en: To combine two or more substances so that they become a single substance, or to be combined in this way.

words.ex: She added pepper to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她往汤里加了胡椒粉。
words.en: Pepper is a hot-tasting powder made from the crushed seeds of certain plants, used to flavor food.

words.ex: He fills the bottle with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子装满水。
words.en: To make or become full; to put something into a container or space so that it is completely or almost completely full.

words.ex: She put the cake in the oven.
words.ex_cn: 她把蛋糕放进烤箱里。
words.en: An oven is a device for cooking food, using dry heat.

words.ex: She put the food on a clean plate.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A flat dish, typically circular and made of china, from which food is eaten or served.

words.tr:
v. 包括；遮盖；报道；
n. 遮盖物；庇护所；封面；
words.ex: The book covers basic math and science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包括基础数学和科学。
words.en: If something covers something else, it has been placed over or upon it, usually in order to protect it or hide it.

words.ex: He poured gravy over the mashed potatoes.
words.ex_cn: 他把肉汁浇在土豆泥上。
words.en: Gravy is a sauce made from the juices that come out of meat when it is cooked, often thickened with flour or cornstarch.

words.tr: v. 效劳；服务；为……工作；招待；
words.ex: He serves the community as a volunteer.
words.ex_cn: 他作为志愿者为社区效劳。
words.en: To perform duties or services for (a person or an organization).

words.ex: The temperature today is very high.
words.ex_cn: 今天的温度很高。
words.en: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object, especially as expressed according to a comparative scale and shown by a thermometer or perceived by touch.

words.ex: I prepare my lunch every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上准备午餐。
words.en: If you prepare something, you make it ready for something that is going to happen.

words.ex: He prepares for the test every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上为考试做准备。
words.en: To make ready or get set for a future event or situation.

words.ex: He passed the exam with high marks.
words.ex_cn: 他以高分通过了考试。
words.en: An exam is a formal test that you take to show your knowledge or ability in a particular subject, or to obtain a qualification.

words.ex: The doctor did an examination of his arm.
words.ex_cn: 医生对他手臂进行了检查。
words.en: An examination is a formal test that you take to show your knowledge or ability in a particular subject, or to obtain a qualification.

words.ex: He stayed home because he had the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他因为得了流感待在家里。
words.en: The flu is an infectious disease characterized by fever, aches and pains, and respiratory symptoms.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: I can't go now, but let's meet another time.
words.ex_cn: 我现在不能去，但我们另找时间见面吧。
words.en: At some future time; on another occasion.

words.tr:
prep. 到…时；直到…为止；
conj. 到…时；直到…为止；
words.ex: He waited until the bus came.
words.ex_cn: 他一直等到公交车来。
words.en: Up to the time of; before (a specified time).

words.tr:
v. 悬挂；吊；
n. 悬挂；
words.ex: He hangs a picture on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一幅画挂在墙上。
words.en: To hang something means to attach it to something else so that it is supported from above and does not touch the ground.

words.tr: phrase. 闲逛；常去某处；挂出
words.ex: They hang out at the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 他们放学后在公园闲逛。
words.en: To spend time idly or casually, often with others.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；赶上；理解；得病；接住；
n. 接住；搭扣；
words.ex: He tried to catch the ball.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抓住球。
words.en: If you catch something or someone, you manage to get hold of them or stop them from moving, often after a chase or search.

words.ex: He accepted the gift with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着接受了这份礼物。
words.en: If you accept something that you have been offered, you say yes to it or agree to take it.

words.ex: He refused to eat the broccoli.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝吃西兰花。
words.en: If you refuse to do something, you deliberately do not do it, or you say firmly that you will not do it.

words.ex: I saw her the day before yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 前天我见过她。
words.en: The day before yesterday refers to the day immediately preceding yesterday.

words.ex: I will go to the park the day after tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我后天去公园。
words.en: The day after tomorrow refers to the day following tomorrow, which is two days from now.

words.tr: n. 工作日（周一至周五中的任何一天）
words.ex: He goes to work every weekday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个工作日都去上班。
words.en: A weekday is any of the days from Monday to Friday, when most people go to work or school.

words.ex: She looks after her little brother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To take care of someone or something.

words.ex: He received an invitation to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了参加派对的邀请。
words.en: An invitation is a written or spoken request to come to an event such as a party, a meal, or a meeting.

words.ex: Please turn down the volume, it's too loud.
words.ex_cn: 请把音量调低，太大声了。
words.en: To refuse or reject an offer or request; to reduce the volume, temperature, or intensity of something.

words.tr:
v. 答复；回答；
n. 答复；回答；
words.ex: He replied to my message quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回复了我的消息。
words.en: To reply means to say or write something as an answer to something that someone has said or written.

words.tr:
adv. 向前；前进；
v. 促进；转交；
adj. 向前的；前进的；
words.ex: He walked forward to meet the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向前走去见老师。
words.en: If you move or look forward, you move or look in a direction that is in front of you. In British English, you can also say that you are looking forward to something that is going to happen.

words.ex: He will delete the old file.
words.ex_cn: 他会删除那个旧文件。
words.en: To delete something means to remove it or erase it.

words.tr:
n. 打印；印刷；
v. 打印；印刷；
words.ex: The print of the photo is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片的打印很清晰。
words.en: To produce text or pictures on paper, usually using a machine called a printer.

words.ex: He felt sad when his dog ran away.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗跑掉时，他感到伤心。
words.en: Feeling or showing sorrow; unhappy.

words.tr:
int. 再见；
n. 说再见；
words.ex: She said goodbye and left the room.
words.ex_cn: 她说再见后离开了房间。
words.en: Goodbye is a conventional expression used at parting.

words.ex: They will take a trip to the beach next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周要去海边旅行。
words.en: Go on a journey or excursion, typically for pleasure or business.

words.ex: I am glad to see you.
words.ex_cn: 我很高兴见到你。
words.en: If you are glad about something, you are happy and pleased about it.

words.ex: The preparation for the exam took two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 考试的准备花了两周时间。
words.en: Preparation is the process of getting something ready for use or for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
n. 胶；胶水；
v. 粘合；
words.ex: He used glue to stick the paper together.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶把纸粘在一起。
words.en: A sticky substance used for joining things together.

words.ex: He cannot swim without water.
words.ex_cn: 没有水，他不会游泳。
words.en: If you do something without something else, you do not have that thing with you or you do not use that thing.

words.tr: adj. 感到惊讶的； v. 使惊奇；使感到意外；“surprise”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I was surprised when I saw the gift.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到礼物时，我感到很惊讶。
words.en: If you are surprised, you have a feeling of surprise, because something unexpected has happened.

words.ex: I look forward to the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我期待着周末。
words.en: If you look forward to something that is going to happen, you want it to happen because you think you will enjoy it.

words.ex: I haven't heard from my friend for a week.
words.ex_cn: 我一周没有收到我朋友的消息了。
words.en: to receive communication from someone

words.tr: n. 新屋落成宴；乔迁庆宴
words.ex: They had a housewarming party last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周末举办了乔迁派对。
words.en: A housewarming is a party that is held to celebrate moving into a new home.

words.tr: n. 开始；开口；空缺职位； v. 打开；“open”的现在分词； adj. 开始的；
words.ex: The opening of the meeting was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 会议的开始被推迟了。
words.en: An opening is a gap or hole in something, or the act of making or becoming open. It can also refer to the beginning of an event or period.

words.tr: n. 音乐会；演奏会；一致；和谐；
words.ex: We went to a concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去听了音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.ex: The headmaster welcomed the new students.
words.ex_cn: 校长欢迎新生。
words.en: A headmaster is the man who is the head teacher of a school.

words.tr: n. 事件；大事；比赛项目；
words.ex: The school event was fun for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 学校的活动对每个人都很有趣。
words.en: An event is something that happens, especially when it is unusual or important.

words.ex: The guest arrived at the party early.
words.ex_cn: 客人早早到了派对。
words.en: A guest is someone who is visiting a place or attending an event by invitation, without having a permanent role there.

words.ex: He checks the calendar every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都看日历。
words.en: A calendar is a chart or device which displays the date and the day of the week, and often the whole of a particular year divided up into months, weeks, and days.

words.ex: We work during the daytime and rest at night.
words.ex_cn: 我们在白天工作，晚上休息。
words.en: The period of the day when there is natural light, from sunrise to sunset.

words.ex: Farmers ted the hay to dry it in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 农民们翻晒干草以便在阳光下晾干。
words.en: To spread out (hay) for drying.

words.tr: n. 文斯（男子名，Vincent 的昵称）
words.ex: Vince wins the race every time.
words.ex_cn: 文斯每次都能赢得比赛。
words.en: A male given name, of Latin origin, meaning 'conquering'.

words.tr: n. （生长于南非的）白葡萄；白葡萄酒; n. （Steen）（丹）斯蒂恩（人名）
words.ex: The winery grows steen to make white wine.
words.ex_cn: 酒庄种植steen来酿造白葡萄酒。
words.en: A surname or given name, of Dutch or Scandinavian origin, meaning 'stone'.

words.ex: Jake is my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 杰克是我最好的朋友。
words.en: A male given name, of Hebrew origin, meaning 'supplanter' (a variant of Jacob).

words.ex: Susan walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 苏珊每天早上走路去学校。
words.en: A female given name, of Hebrew origin, meaning 'lily'.

words.tr: n. 会议；会面； v. 遇见；见面；“meet”的现在分词；
words.ex: The meeting starts at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 会议上午九点开始。
words.en: A meeting is an event in which a group of people come together to discuss things or make decisions.

words.tr:
n. 视频；录像；
adj. 视频的；录像的；
words.ex: I watched a short video on YouTube.
words.ex_cn: 我看了一个YouTube上的短视频。
words.en: A recording of moving visual images made digitally or on videotape.

words.ex: She will organize a meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 她明天将安排一次会议。
words.en: To organize something means to arrange it in a systematic way, especially on a large scale.

words.tr: phrase. 马铃薯片；炸土豆片
words.ex: He eats potato chips every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上吃薯片。
words.en: Thin slices of potato that have been deep-fried or baked until crunchy and are often eaten as a snack.

words.ex: He ate a piece of chocolate after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一块巧克力。
words.en: A food preparation in the form of a paste or solid block made from roasted and ground cacao seeds, typically sweetened.

words.tr:
adj. 难过的；沮丧的；
v. 打乱；使心烦；
words.ex: He felt upset when his dog ran away.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗跑掉时，他感到很难过。
words.en: If you are upset, you are unhappy or disappointed because something unpleasant has happened to you.

words.ex: I took a taxi to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 我打了一辆出租车去机场。
words.en: A taxi is a car driven by someone whose job is to take people where they want to go in return for money.

words.ex: My teacher gave me good advice about studying.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师给了我关于学习的好建议。
words.en: If you give someone advice, you tell them what you think they should do in a particular situation.

words.tr:
n. 旅游；旅行；
v. 旅游；旅行；
words.ex: His travel to Japan was unforgettable.
words.ex_cn: 他去日本的旅游令人难忘。
words.en: If you travel, you go from one place to another, often to a place that is far away.

words.tr: n. 代理人；特工；经纪人；（药）剂；动因；
words.ex: The real estate agent helped them buy a house.
words.ex_cn: 房地产代理人帮助他们买了一所房子。
words.en: An agent is a person who acts on behalf of another person or group.

words.tr:
n. 专家；行家；
adj. 内行的；老练的；专门的；
words.ex: He is an expert in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他是计算机科学方面的专家。
words.en: A person who is very knowledgeable about or skillful in a particular area.

words.tr: phrase. 将…秘而不宣；对…守口如瓶；不与他人分享…
words.ex: He decided to keep his feelings to himself.
words.ex_cn: 他决定把自己的感受藏在心里。
words.en: If you keep something to yourself, you do not tell anyone else about it.

words.tr: n. （十三到十九岁的）青少年
words.ex: The teenager walks to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个青少年每天步行上学。
words.en: A teenager is someone who is between thirteen and nineteen years old.

words.ex: His temperature is normal.
words.ex_cn: 他的体温正常。
words.en: Something that is normal is usual and ordinary, and is what people expect.

words.ex: You won't pass the test unless you study.
words.ex_cn: 除非你学习，否则你不会通过考试。
words.en: You use unless to introduce the only circumstances in which an event you are mentioning will not take place or in which a statement you are making is not true.

words.tr: adv. 毫无疑问地；确定地；当然；
words.ex: He will certainly come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他毫无疑问会来参加派对。
words.en: Without doubt; definitely.

words.ex: He lost his wallet on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交车上丢了钱包。
words.en: A wallet is a small flat folding case made of leather or plastic, in which you can keep banknotes, credit cards, and other small flat objects.

words.ex: He walks one mile to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天步行一英里去学校。
words.en: A unit of linear measure equal to 1,760 yards (approximately 1.609 kilometers).

words.ex: He became angry when his phone broke.
words.ex_cn: 当他手机坏了时，他生气了。
words.en: Feeling or showing strong annoyance, displeasure, or hostility; full of anger.

words.tr: n. 理解；了解； v. “understand”的现在分词；
words.ex: His understanding of the problem helped solve it quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题的理解帮助快速解决了它。
words.en: An understanding is a mutual agreement or sympathy between people or groups.

words.ex: He made a careless mistake on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中犯了一个粗心的错误。
words.en: If you are careless, you do not pay enough attention to what you are doing, and so you make mistakes, or cause harm or damage.

words.ex: He made a mistake in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you make a mistake, you do something which you did not intend to do, or which produces a result that you do not want.

words.ex: He cleaned the room himself.
words.ex_cn: 他亲自打扫了房间。
words.en: used as the object of a verb or preposition when the male subject of the verb is also the object

words.ex: Be careful when you cross the street.
words.ex_cn: 过马路时要小心。
words.en: If you are careful, you give serious attention to what you are doing, in order to avoid harm, damage, or mistakes.

words.ex: I advise you to eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 我建议你多吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you advise someone to do something, you tell them what you think they should do.

words.ex: He solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解决了这道数学题。
words.en: If you solve a problem or a question, you find a solution or an answer to it.

words.tr:
n. 步；步骤；踏级；步伐；
v. 踩；踏；行走；
words.ex: He took a small step forward.
words.ex_cn: 他向前迈了一小步。
words.en: A step is an act or movement of putting one leg in front of the other in order to move forward, or a stage in a process.

words.tr:
n. 信任；信赖；
v. 信任；信赖；
words.ex: I have trust in my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 我信任我最好的朋友。
words.en: If you trust someone, you believe that they are honest and sincere and will not deliberately do anything to harm you.

words.tr:
n. 经验；阅历；
v. 经历；体验；
words.ex: He has a lot of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity that you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

words.ex: She cut the apple in half.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果切成两半。
words.en: Into two equal parts.

words.ex: He stopped halfway to rest.
words.ex_cn: 他在半路停下来休息。
words.en: At or to a point midway between two others.

words.ex: Karen is talking on the phone.
words.ex_cn: 凯伦正在打电话。
words.en: A colloquial term for an entitled, often confrontational woman, typically perceived as demanding or unreasonable.

words.tr: v. 用来表示某人或某物即主语本身；用来表示某人或某物属于某一群体或有某种性质；用来表示某人或某物即主语本身，用来表示某人或某物属于某一群体或有某种性质（ be的过去分词 ）；
words.ex: I have been to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 我去过巴黎。
words.en: Past participle of be.

words.ex: Michael likes to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 迈克尔喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: Michael is a male given name, derived from the Hebrew name מִיכָאֵל (Mikha'el), meaning 'Who is like God?'.

words.ex: Laura goes to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 劳拉每天去上学。
words.en: A female given name of Latin origin, meaning 'laurel'.

words.tr: n. 磨坊；磨粉机；磨坊( mill的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The old mills stand by the river.
words.ex_cn: 旧磨坊伫立在河边。
words.en: A mill is a building in which grain is crushed to make flour, or a factory where a particular substance is produced.

words.ex: Robert likes to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 罗伯特喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: A common male given name, of Germanic origin meaning 'bright fame'.

words.ex: He hunts deer in the forest every autumn.
words.ex_cn: 他每年秋天在森林里打猎。
words.en: To hunt means to chase and try to catch or kill animals for food or sport.

words.tr:
n. 事情；物质；
v. 要紧；
words.ex: What's the matter with you?
words.ex_cn: 你怎么了？
words.en: Matter is a physical substance in general, as distinct from mind and spirit; (in physics) that which occupies space and possesses rest mass, especially as distinct from energy. It can also refer to a subject or situation under consideration.

words.ex: What's the matter? He looks sad.
words.ex_cn: 怎么了？他看起来很难过。
words.en: A question asking what is wrong or what is causing a problem or distress.

words.ex: My throat is sore after singing.
words.ex_cn: 我唱歌后喉咙疼。
words.en: If part of your body is sore, it causes you pain and discomfort.

words.ex: He has a cold and stays at home.
words.ex_cn: 他感冒了，待在家里。
words.en: To suffer from a minor illness that makes you sneeze and cough and gives you a sore throat.

words.ex: He had a stomachache after eating too much ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了太多冰淇淋后胃痛。
words.en: A stomachache is a pain in your stomach.

words.ex: He hurt his foot while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了脚。
words.en: The lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks.

words.ex: He hurt his neck while lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他在举重时伤了脖子。
words.en: The part of a person's or animal's body connecting the head to the rest of the body.

words.ex: He ate too much and his stomach hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多了，胃疼。
words.en: The stomach is the organ in your body where food is digested after you have eaten it.

words.ex: He had a sore throat after singing all night.
words.ex_cn: 他唱了一整晚后喉咙疼。
words.en: Your throat is the back part of your mouth, where it connects to your neck. It includes the passage that leads from your mouth to your stomach and lungs.

words.ex: He has a high fever and stays in bed.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧了，躺在床上休息。
words.en: A fever is a condition in which the body's temperature is higher than usual, often as a response to infection.

words.tr:
v. 躺；撒谎；
n. 谎言；
words.ex: The cat lies on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫躺在沙发上。
words.en: If someone is lying, they are saying something which they know is not true.

words.tr: phrase. 躺下；接受；忍受；逃避（职责）
words.ex: He lies down after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后躺下。
words.en: To recline or rest in a horizontal position.

words.tr:
n. 剩余部分；其他；休息；
v. （使）休息；（使）倚靠；停留在；
words.ex: He ate the first slice and left the rest for his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了第一块，把剩下的留给了他妹妹。
words.en: To rest means to cease work or movement in order to relax, sleep, or recover strength. It can also refer to the remaining part of something.

words.tr:
n. 咳嗽；
v. 咳嗽；
words.ex: He had a bad cough last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚咳得很厉害。
words.en: A cough is a sudden, forceful expulsion of air from the lungs, often caused by irritation in the airway.

words.ex: The doctor used an x-ray to check his bone.
words.ex_cn: 医生用X光检查了他的骨头。
words.en: An X-ray is a type of radiation that can pass through most solid materials. X-rays are used in medicine to make images of the inside of the body.

words.ex: He has a toothache and cannot eat.
words.ex_cn: 他牙疼，不能吃东西。
words.en: A toothache is a pain in or around a tooth.

words.ex: The nurse takes her temperature every morning.
words.ex_cn: 护士每天早上给她量体温。
words.en: To measure someone's body temperature, usually to check for fever.

words.tr: n. 头痛；令人头痛的人（或事物）；
words.ex: He got a headache after working too long.
words.ex_cn: 他工作太长时间后得了头痛。
words.en: A headache is a pain in your head. If you say that something is a headache, you mean that it causes you difficulty or worry.

words.ex: He has a fever and stays in bed.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧了，待在床上。
words.en: To suffer from a higher than normal body temperature, often as a symptom of illness.

words.tr:
v. 打破；打断；
n. 休息；中断；破裂；
words.ex: He broke the glass by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打破了玻璃。
words.en: If you break something, you cause it to separate into two or more pieces, often in a way that is irreparable.

words.tr: phrase. 休息；暂停工作或活动
words.ex: He takes breaks every hour to rest his eyes.
words.ex_cn: 他每小时休息一下来放松眼睛。
words.en: To pause from work or activity in order to relax or refresh oneself.

words.tr: phrase. 休息一下；暂停工作或活动
words.ex: He takes a break after working for two hours.
words.ex_cn: 他工作两小时后休息一下。
words.en: To stop doing something for a short period of time in order to rest or do something else.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: If you hurt someone, you cause them to feel pain. If you hurt a part of your body, you feel pain there. If someone is hurt, they are injured.

words.ex: She cleaned the room herself.
words.ex_cn: 她自己打扫了房间。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition when the female subject of the verb is also the object.

words.ex: She is reading a book.
words.ex_cn: 她正在读书。
words.en: used to refer to a woman, girl, or female animal previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.tr:
n. 绷带
v. 用绷带包扎
words.ex: He put a bandage on his cut finger.
words.ex_cn: 他在他割伤的手指上贴了绷带。
words.en: A bandage is a piece of material used to cover a wound or to support an injured part of the body.

words.ex: He is sick and cannot go to school.
words.ex_cn: 他生病了，不能去上学。
words.en: If you are sick, you are ill. Sick can also mean feeling nauseous or wanting to vomit. Additionally, it can describe being very tired of something or someone because you have experienced too much of them.

words.ex: He fell and hurt his knee.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒了，伤了膝盖。
words.en: The knee is the joint between the thigh and the lower leg in humans.

words.ex: He got a nosebleed after hitting his head.
words.ex_cn: 他撞到头后流鼻血了。
words.en: A nosebleed is the loss of blood from the tissue that lines the inside of your nose.

words.tr:
v. 打；击；碰撞；袭击；抨击；达到；
n. 打；击；碰撞；袭击；(演出等)成功；
words.ex: He hit the ball with a bat.
words.ex_cn: 他用球棒打了球。
words.en: If you hit someone or something, you deliberately touch them with a lot of force, with your hand or an object held in your hand.

words.ex: He cannot breathe when he runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得快时无法呼吸。
words.en: To breathe means to take air into your lungs and then expel it, a process necessary for life.

words.tr:
adj. 晒黑的；晒伤的
v. 晒黑；晒伤；“sunburn”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: His arms are sunburned after playing outside all day.
words.ex_cn: 他在外面玩了一整天，胳膊晒黑了。
words.en: If someone is sunburned, their skin is bright pink and sore because they have spent too much time in hot sunshine.

words.ex: We cleaned the house ourselves.
words.ex_cn: 我们自己打扫了房子。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition when this is the same as the subject of the clause and the subject is the speaker and one or more other people considered together.

words.ex: We are eating lunch now.
words.ex_cn: 我们正在吃午饭。
words.en: We is the first person plural pronoun used by a speaker or writer to refer to themselves and one or more other people considered together.

words.ex: The climber reached the top of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这位登山者登上了山顶。
words.en: A climber is someone who climbs mountains or rocks as a sport or hobby, or a plant that grows upwards by clinging to a support.

words.ex: He used to play soccer every day.
words.ex_cn: 他过去每天踢足球。
words.en: If something used to be done or used to be the case, it was done regularly in the past or was the case in the past.

words.tr:
n. 风险；
v. 冒...的危险；
words.ex: He took a risk by starting his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他创业时承担了风险。
words.en: If there is a risk of something unpleasant, there is a possibility that it will happen.

words.ex: He takes risks to start his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他冒险创业。
words.en: To undertake actions or decisions that involve the possibility of loss or failure.

words.ex: He took a risk and started his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他冒了一个险，开了自己的公司。
words.en: To do something that involves the possibility of danger, loss, or failure.

words.tr: n. 事故；意外事件；意外；
words.ex: He was hurt in a car accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在一场车祸中受伤了。
words.en: An accident is an unexpected and undesirable event, especially one resulting in damage or harm.

words.ex: The situation is very serious.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况非常严重。
words.en: A situation is all the circumstances and things that are happening at a particular time and in a particular place.

words.ex: He bought two kilos of apples.
words.ex_cn: 他买了两公斤苹果。
words.en: A kilo is a unit of measurement equal to 1,000 grams or approximately 2.2 pounds. It is commonly used to measure weight.

words.ex: The apple weighs one kilogram.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果重一公斤。
words.en: A kilogram is a unit of mass equal to one thousand grams.

words.tr:
n. 岩石；摇滚乐；
v. （使）摇动；（使）摇晃；
words.ex: The children climbed on the big rock near the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边的大岩石上攀爬。
words.en: A rock is a large piece of stone that forms part of a hill or mountain. Rock can also refer to a type of music that is loud and has a strong beat. As a verb, to rock means to move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side.

words.tr: phrase. 用完；耗尽；跑出去；到期
words.ex: We run out of milk every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们每星期天都把牛奶喝光了。
words.en: If you run out of something, you have no more of it left.

words.ex: We ran out of milk this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们今天早上牛奶喝完了。
words.en: If you run out of something, you have no more of it left.

words.ex: He cut the bread with a knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用刀切面包。
words.en: A knife is a tool for cutting or a weapon, consisting of a flat piece of metal with a sharp edge on the end of a handle.

words.tr:
adv. 离；断开；
prep. 离开；脱落；
adj. 空闲的；远离的；
int. 走开；
words.ex: The boat moved off from the shore.
words.ex_cn: 船离开了岸边。
words.en: If something is off, it is not on or is not being used.

words.ex: He cut off the power during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他在风暴期间切断了电源。
words.en: To stop the supply of something, or to stop something from continuing.

words.ex: He lost a lot of blood after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失了很多血。
words.en: The red liquid that flows through the bodies of humans and animals, carrying oxygen and nutrients.

words.tr:
v. 意思；导致；打算；
n. 平均数；
adj. 低劣；平均；
words.ex: What does this word mean?
words.ex_cn: 这个词是什么意思？
words.en: If you want to know what a word, a sentence, or an expression means, you want to know what it refers to or what its significance is.

words.ex: He wants to get out of debt.
words.ex_cn: 他想摆脱债务。
words.en: To leave a place or situation; to avoid doing something that you do not want to do.

words.ex: The importance of homework is clear.
words.ex_cn: 作业的重要性是显而易见的。
words.en: The quality or state of being important; significance.

words.ex: He made a quick decision to leave.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速做出了离开的决定。
words.en: A decision is a choice that you make about something after thinking about it.

words.tr:
n. 控制；管制；
v. 控制；操纵；
words.ex: The teacher has good control of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师对课堂有很好的控制。
words.en: To control something means to have power over it and to be able to make it do what you want.

words.tr: phrase. 控制；掌管；对……有控制力
words.ex: He is in control of the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他掌控着这台机器。
words.en: To have the power to influence or direct people's behavior or the course of events.

words.ex: He showed great spirit when he tried again after failing.
words.ex_cn: 他在失败后再次尝试时展现了极大的精神。
words.en: The part of a person that includes their mind, feelings, and character rather than their body.

words.ex: His death made everyone very sad.
words.ex_cn: 他的去世让所有人都很难过。
words.en: The end of the life of a person or organism.

words.ex: He gave up smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年戒烟了。
words.en: If you give up something, you stop doing it or having it.

words.tr:
n. 麻烦；问题；困难；
v. 费神；
words.ex: He got into trouble for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而惹上了麻烦。
words.en: If you say that someone is in trouble, you mean that they are in a situation that is difficult to deal with and that may cause them problems.

words.ex: The nurse gave the patient medicine.
words.ex_cn: 护士给病人服了药。
words.en: A nurse is a person whose job is to care for people who are ill or injured, especially in a hospital.

words.ex: The young judy danced at the party all night.
words.ex_cn: 那个轻佻的姑娘整晚都在派对上跳舞。
words.en: A common female given name, often a diminutive of Judith, meaning 'woman of Judea'.

words.tr: n. 女人气的男子；同性恋男子；
words.ex: He dresses like a nancy and always carries a handbag.
words.ex_cn: 他打扮得像个娘娘腔，总是带着手提包。
words.en: Nancy is a female given name, often a diminutive form of Ann or Anna.

words.tr: n. 曼蒂（女子名）；镇静片（等于 Mandrax）
words.ex: Mandy is eating an apple.
words.ex_cn: 曼迪正在吃一个苹果。
words.en: Mandy is a female given name, often a diminutive form of Amanda.

words.tr: 专有名词，美国登山者、演说家和作家，因2003年在犹他州峡谷中被困后自行截肢幸存而闻名
words.ex: Aron Ralston cut his arm to survive in the canyon.
words.ex_cn: 阿隆·拉尔斯顿为了在峡谷中生存，砍断了自己的手臂。
words.en: An American mountaineer and motivational speaker, famous for his survival story after amputating his own arm to free himself from a boulder.

words.tr: n. 犹他州（美国西部的一个州）
words.ex: He lives in Utah.
words.ex_cn: 他住在犹他州。
words.en: A state in the western United States, known for its national parks and skiing.

words.tr: phrase. 打扫干净；收拾整洁
words.ex: They clean up the room every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每星期六打扫房间。
words.en: To make a place or thing clean and tidy by removing dirt, rubbish, or unwanted items.

words.ex: The crowd cheered when the team scored.
words.ex_cn: 当球队得分时，观众欢呼起来。
words.en: If people cheer, they shout loudly to show their approval or to encourage someone who is doing something such as taking part in a game.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 使高兴起来；振作起来
words.ex: He smiled to cheer up his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着让妹妹振作起来。
words.en: If someone cheers up, or if something cheers them up, they start to feel happier.

words.tr: phrase. 分发；发出；发表；用尽
words.ex: He gives out books to the students.
words.ex_cn: 他把书分发给学生们。
words.en: To distribute or hand out something; to emit or produce something such as a sound or smell; to announce or make something known publicly.

words.tr:
n. 志愿者；
v. 自愿做；
words.ex: He is a volunteer at the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地医院的一名志愿者。
words.en: A volunteer is someone who does work without being paid for it, especially work that involves helping people.

words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.ex: He put off his homework until tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业推迟到明天。
words.en: To delay something or to cause someone to feel dislike or lack of interest.

words.tr:
v. 做标记；签名；
n. 征兆；手势；符号；标志；告示牌；
words.ex: Sign the box with a checkmark.
words.ex_cn: 用对勾在盒子上做标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. It can also be an event, action, or fact that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.

words.tr:
n. 注意；通知；
v. 注意；留心；通知；
words.ex: He gave a notice about the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他发布了关于会议的通知。
words.en: If you notice something or someone, you become aware of them.

words.ex: The teacher will hand out the papers now.
words.ex_cn: 老师现在会分发试卷。
words.en: To distribute something to a group of people.

words.tr: phrase. 给…打电话；使想起；召集
words.ex: He called up his friend to say hello.
words.ex_cn: 他给朋友打电话问好。
words.en: To telephone someone; to summon someone to military service; to bring something back to one's mind.

words.ex: He used to play soccer every day.
words.ex_cn: 他过去每天踢足球。
words.en: If something used to be done or used to be the case, it was done regularly in the past or was the case in the past.

words.tr: adj. 孤独的；寂寞的；偏僻的；
words.ex: He felt lonely after his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗去世后，他感到孤独。
words.en: If you are lonely, you are unhappy because you are alone or do not have anyone you can talk to.

words.tr: phrase. 照料；关怀；喜欢；想要
words.ex: She cares for her sick mother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她生病的母亲。
words.en: To like or love someone or something; to look after someone or something.

words.ex: The homeless man slept on the bench.
words.ex_cn: 那个无家可归的人睡在长椅上。
words.en: If someone is homeless, they have no permanent place to live.

words.tr: v. 增加；引起；筹募；提起；养育；
words.ex: The company will raise wages next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将提高工资。
words.en: To raise something means to move it to a higher position or to increase it in amount or level.

words.tr:
adv. 单独；独自；
adj. 独自的；孤独的；
words.ex: He walked alone in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他独自在公园里散步。
words.en: If you are alone, you are not with any other people.

words.tr:
n. 修理；修补；
v. 修理；修补；
words.ex: The repair of the car took two days.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的修理花了两天时间。
words.en: To repair something that is damaged or not working properly means to fix it.

words.ex: He will fix the broken chair tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会修理那把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: To fix something means to repair it, to make it firm or stable, or to arrange or decide it.

words.tr: phrase. 修理；安排； 为（某人）提供
words.ex: He will fix up his bike tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要修理他的自行车。
words.en: To repair, arrange, or organize something.

words.tr: phrase. 赠送；分发；背叛；泄露
words.ex: He will give away his old books to the library.
words.ex_cn: 他将把他的旧书捐给图书馆。
words.en: To give something to someone without asking for payment, or to reveal something secret or private.

words.ex: He takes after his father in looks.
words.ex_cn: 他在长相上像他父亲。
words.en: If you take after a member of your family, you resemble them in your appearance, your behaviour, or your character.

words.tr: adj. 破损的；弄坏的； v. 打破；打断；“break”的过去分词；
words.ex: The broken cup lay on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 破了的杯子躺在地板上。
words.en: Damaged or shattered into pieces, typically as a result of force or impact.

words.ex: The car has four wheels.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有四个车轮。
words.en: A wheel is a circular object that revolves on an axle and is fixed below a vehicle or other object to enable it to move easily over the ground.

words.ex: A is the first letter in the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: A 是英语字母表中的第一个字母。
words.en: A letter is a written message that can be handwritten or printed on paper. It is usually sent in an envelope by post or messenger.

words.tr:
v. 错过；想念；漏掉；
n. 小姐；
words.ex: I missed the bus this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上错过了公交车。
words.en: To fail to hit, reach, catch, or otherwise make contact with something; to feel the absence or loss of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

words.tr: adj. 残疾的； v. “disable”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The disabled man uses a wheelchair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 这位残疾人使用轮椅行动。
words.en: If someone is disabled, they are unable to use part of their body or mind properly, for example, because of injury or illness.

words.tr: phrase. 要紧；区别对待；有影响；起（重要）作用
words.ex: Volunteering can make a difference in your community.
words.ex_cn: 志愿服务能为你的社区带来改变。
words.en: If something makes a difference, it affects someone or something positively, especially in a noticeable or important way.

words.ex: The blind man walks with a white cane.
words.ex_cn: 这位失明的男人用白色手杖走路。
words.en: Unable to see; lacking the sense of sight.

words.ex: He is deaf and uses sign language to communicate.
words.ex_cn: 他是聋的，使用手语交流。
words.en: If someone is deaf, they cannot hear anything, or they cannot hear very well.

words.ex: Can you imagine a world without phones?
words.ex_cn: 你能想象一个没有电话的世界吗？
words.en: To imagine means to form a mental image or concept of something that is not present or real.

words.ex: He faced difficulty in solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决这道数学题时遇到了困难。
words.en: A difficulty is a problem or issue that is hard to deal with or understand.

words.tr:
adj. 开放的；营业的；
v. 打开；开放；
n. 公开；户外；
words.ex: The park is open to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园对所有人开放。
words.en: If you open something such as a door, window, or lid, or if it opens, you move it so that it no longer covers a hole or gap.

words.ex: He closed the door quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻地关上了门。
words.en: A door is a piece of wood, glass, or metal, which is moved to open and close the entrance to a building, room, cupboard, or vehicle.

words.ex: He carries a bag to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带一个包去学校。
words.en: To carry something means to move it while supporting it, especially in your hands or arms.

words.tr:
n. 火车；列车；列；队；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: I took the train to work this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上我坐火车去上班。
words.en: A train is a number of carriages or trucks which are all connected together and which are pulled by an engine along a railway. Train also means to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills.

words.tr: adj. 兴奋的； v. 使兴奋；使激动；“excite”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children were excited about the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们对派对感到兴奋。
words.en: If you are excited, you are so happy that you cannot relax, usually because you are thinking about something pleasant that you are going to do or experience.

words.tr: n. 培训；训练；锻炼； v. “train”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company provided free training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供了免费培训。
words.en: The process of learning the skills you need to do a particular job or activity.

words.ex: Her kindness helped me when I was sad.
words.ex_cn: 当我不开心时，她的善意帮助了我。
words.en: Kindness is the quality of being gentle, caring, and helpful.

words.ex: The clever boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个聪明的男孩很快解决了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is clever is intelligent and able to understand things easily or plan things well.

words.ex: I understand the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 我理解这个数学问题。
words.en: If you understand someone or understand what they are saying, you know what they mean.

words.tr: v. 明白；懂得；“understand”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 懂得的；
words.ex: I understood the lesson quickly.
words.ex_cn: 我很快明白了这堂课的内容。
words.en: Past tense and past participle of understand, which means to perceive the intended meaning of (words, a language, or a speaker).

words.tr:
n. 变化；变革；
v. 变化；变革；
words.ex: There was a big change in the weather.
words.ex_cn: 天气发生了很大的变化。
words.en: To make or become different; to alter or modify; to exchange or replace something with another.

words.tr:
pron. 几个；一些；
adj. 不同的；
words.ex: I have several books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我桌上放着几本书。
words.en: Several means a number of people or things that is more than a few but not a lot.

words.ex: He is strong enough to lift the box.
words.ex_cn: 他很强壮，足以举起这个箱子。
words.en: Someone who is strong is healthy with good muscles and can move or carry heavy things, or do hard physical work.

words.tr: n. 感觉； v. 感到；“feel”的现在分词；
words.ex: I have a feeling it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我感觉明天会下雨。
words.en: An emotion or a physical sensation.

words.ex: He felt satisfaction after finishing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他完成作业后感到满意。
words.en: The feeling of pleasure that you have when you do or get something that you wanted or needed.

words.ex: The children screamed with joy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们因喜悦而尖叫。
words.en: Joy is a feeling of great happiness.

words.tr: n. 所有权人；主人；物主；
words.ex: The owner of the house sold it last week.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的主人上周把它卖了。
words.en: The owner of something is the person to whom it belongs.

words.tr: phrase. 参加…选拔；测试；试验
words.ex: He wants to try out for the school soccer team.
words.ex_cn: 他想参加校足球队的选拔。
words.en: To test something to see if it is suitable or effective.

words.ex: They went on a long journey by train.
words.ex_cn: 他们乘火车进行了一次长途旅行。
words.en: A journey is the act of traveling from one place to another, especially when this involves a long distance or a lot of time.

words.tr:
n. 兴趣；利息；利益；
v. 使产生兴趣；
words.ex: He has a strong interest in painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画有浓厚的兴趣。
words.en: If you have an interest in something, you want to learn or hear more about it.

words.ex: Thank you, sir.
words.ex_cn: 谢谢，先生。
words.en: A polite or formal way of addressing a man, especially one whose name you do not know or a man of higher rank or status.

words.ex: Madam, can you help me with this question?
words.ex_cn: 夫人，您能帮我回答这个问题吗？
words.en: A polite form of address for a woman, especially one who is married or of higher social status.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.tr: n. 短撬棍，铁撬棍（窃贼撬门窗用）（等于jemmy）；
words.ex: The thief used a jimmy to break the window.
words.ex_cn: 小偷用一根短撬棍撬开了窗户。
words.en: A jimmy is a short crowbar used by burglars to force open windows and doors.

words.tr: n. 马里奥（男性名字，常用于意大利语名字）
words.ex: Mario plays video games every day.
words.ex_cn: 马里奥每天玩电子游戏。
words.en: A common male given name, of Italian origin, famously associated with the Nintendo video game character.
